metadata.title: Global Hyperbolicity Criterion for Regular Sub-Lorentzian Manifolds
metadata.abstract: This paper investigates the global hyperbolicity of regular sub-Lorentzian manifolds. We establish a criterion for global hyperbolicity on complete Riemannian manifolds, formulated in terms of a smooth time function and an admissible growth function. The proof relies on the theory of differential inclusions. The proposed condition relaxes the classical requirements on the differential of the time function. The effectiveness of the obtained criterion is illustrated on classical nonholonomic structures: the Grushin space, the Heisenberg group, and step-2 Carnot groups, for which we find explicit asymptotic bounds on the expansion rate of causal cones that guarantee the preservation of global hyperbolicity.
